name: comp-446
title: Breadcrumb Ellipsis Dropdown
description: A flat line of breadcrumb links with a three-dot button in the middle that drops a small menu of the pages left out: Documentation, Themes and GitHub.
use: Long file or category paths where the middle crumbs should stay out of the way.
avoid: When every crumb must be visible at once: the middle pages hide behind a click.
a11y: The ellipsis trigger has a screen-reader label and the menu is keyboard reachable; no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: One line of small grey breadcrumb labels separated by chevrons runs across black and ends in a bright Breadcrumb. In the middle, a three-dot button opens a dark rounded menu holding three plain text rows.
behaves: Clicking the three dots drops the menu beneath it; hovering a row fills it grey, and the trigger gains a soft rounded outline on hover or focus. Choosing a row closes the menu.
customise: The path labels, separators and the three menu rows are written inside; showing a real path means editing those items. Hover and menu styling come from shared pieces.
weight: light: A handful of text links and one small menu; no loops or heavy animation.
